definition.title: Load tariff tables as dbt seeds

acceptance.text: `dbt seed` loads all 40 tariff tables without errors
Model `fct_billing` joins the seeds and its tests pass
The refresh command is documented in README

questions.text: Which tariff export is the source of truth, the monthly CSV or the API?
questions.why: The two differ for 3 of 40 tariffs; the seed must pick one.

questions.text: Should `valid_from` in the seeds be a DATE or a TIMESTAMP?
questions.why: Tariffs change at midnight local time, but the meter readings join on UTC timestamps. DATE is simpler, TIMESTAMP avoids a cast in fct_billing.

body.summary: Tariff tables live in a shared drive as 40 CSV files. Load them into the warehouse as dbt seeds so billing models can join them and the data is reviewed in git.
body.context:
- Repo: `acme-energy-dbt`, seeds go to `seeds/tariffs/`.
- Related: DEMO-0040 (epic), DEMO-0041 (reconciliation tests need these seeds).
- The monthly CSV export is produced by finance on the 1st; the tariff API lags by one day.

body.requirements:
- All 40 tariff tables are loaded with explicit column types.
- Seeds are refreshable with a single documented command.
- `fct_billing` joins the seeds, tests cover tariff changes inside a month.
body.out_of_scope:
- Live tariff API ingestion.
- Historic tariffs before 2022.
body.plan:
1. Export the CSVs (T1).
2. Add `seeds/tariffs/schema.yml` with column types (T2).
3. Join in `fct_billing` and add tests (T3).
4. Document `make refresh-tariffs` in the README (T4).

T2 and T3 run in parallel as subagent leases.
body.decisions:
- **Chosen:** monthly CSV is the source of truth (Q1, Mara).
- **Rejected:** API as source, because it lags one day and costs +1 day of work.
body.verification:
- `dbt seed --select tariffs` exits 0 and loads 40 tables.
- `dbt test --select fct_billing` passes.

definition.title: Add outage windows to usage forecast

acceptance.text: Forecast excludes planned outage windows from the grid operator calendar

tasks.text: Load the grid operator outage calendar as a source

body.summary: Planned outages distort the usage forecast. Pull the operator calendar and mask the windows.
body.context: The grid operator publishes planned outages a week ahead. Forecast days with an outage show a dip that is not demand.
body.requirements:
- Load the operator calendar daily.
- Exclude outage windows from the forecast training data.
body.plan:
1. Source for the outage calendar.
2. Mask the windows in fct_usage_forecast and test it.
body.decisions: Mask by hour, not by day.
body.verification: dbt test on fct_usage_forecast proves AC1.
body.current_state:
T1 is done. T2's check fails: the mask drops the whole day when a window crosses midnight.

```orch
{"type":"timeline","id":"so-far","title":"So far","source":"ticket log","items":[{"at":"2026-10-07","label":"Plan approved","status":"done"},{"at":"2026-10-08T14:10Z","label":"T1 done: outage calendar source","status":"done"},{"at":"2026-10-09T09:55Z","label":"T2 check fails","status":"failed","note":"A window across midnight drops the whole day."},{"at":"2026-10-09T11:30Z","label":"Mask by hour","status":"current"},{"at":"2026-10-10","label":"Verdict","status":"next"}]}

```
